text: square symmetric matrix (dense sparse) representing co-occurrence counts. method Character. Normalization method: "none" normalization. Returns raw co-occurrence counts. "association" Association strength (probabilistic affinity index). \(s_{ij} = c_{ij} / (w_i \cdot w_j)\). Often recommended best normalization co-occurrence data. "cosine" Salton's cosine. \(s_{ij} = c_{ij} / \sqrt{w_i \cdot w_j}\). "jaccard" Jaccard index. \(s_{ij} = c_{ij} / (w_i + w_j - c_{ij})\). title: bibnets 0.4.2
text: Title renamed “Importing, Constructing, Exporting Bibliometric Networks” reflect full lifecycle scope. Description rewritten lead attention-weighted networks (lead, last, proximity, circular) differentiators (position-aware counting, similarity/dissimilarity normalisations, temporal windows, disparity-filter backbone, historiograph, local citation scoring), dropping enumeration standard co-network types. README intro re-leads capabilities; numerical method counts removed. Internal-comment author attributions stripped throughout.

title: bibnets 0.4.1
text: read_lens() longer inflates output n^2 rows neither Lens ID ID columns present. read_openalex() longer inflates output n^2 rows id column absent. read_scopus() now normalises empty-string DOIs NA, .na(doi) deduplication checks behave expected. read_wos() empty-file return now includes keywords_plus list-column match non-empty schema. read_crossref() longer crashes “row names contain missing values” issued column NA entries.

title: bibnets 0.4.1
text: Converter examples (to_igraph(), to_tbl_graph(), to_cograph()) now use @examplesIf requireNamespace(...) execute suggested package installed instead silently skipped. read_biblio(), read_bibtex(), read_ris() now ship runnable examples backed either bundled extdata/openalex_works.csv fixture tempfile()-based minimal record. Reference list streamlined across DESCRIPTION, README, vignette, Rd files.

title: bibnets 0.4.1
text: Added eight new test files covering read_scopus(), read_wos(), read_ris(), read_lens(), read_dimensions(), read_crossref(), read_biblio(), read_openalex(), plus dedicated coverage R/edgelist.R build_bipartite_long(). Suite size: 1268 tests (499). Package line coverage: 92.5% (61.8%).

title: bibnets 0.3.0
text: temporal_network() — builds time-windowed networks fixed, sliding, cumulative strategies. Results include window column easy stacking. historiograph() — Garfield-style chronological citation network among locally cited documents. local_citations() — counts within-dataset citations (Local Citation Score). backbone() — disparity filter extracting statistically significant edges dense weighted networks. prune() — threshold top-n edge pruning. read_biblio() — universal reader auto-format detection (Scopus, WoS, BibTeX, RIS, Dimensions, Lens.org). read_dimensions() — Dimensions CSV export reader. read_crossref() — converter rcrossref::cr_works() output. to_gephi() — exports node edge tables Gephi CSV format; writes nodes.csv + edges.csv directory path supplied. to_graphml() — pure base-R GraphML writer; XML package required. to_cograph() — converts edge list cograph_network object optional node metadata direct use cograph::splot().

title: bibnets 0.3.0
text: edge list functions now sort output weight descending reset row names. local_citations() canonical column order: id, lcs, gcs, year, title, journal, doi. historiograph() empty-result schema matches non-empty schema. readers share standard column order: id, title, year, journal, doi, cited_by_count, abstract, type, authors, references, keywords, source-specific extras. backbone() prune() use single-pass O(m) node statistics via tapply() / split() — faster large networks. temporal_network() converted loop lapply. read_dimensions() / read_crossref() now apply standardize_authors() standardize_refs() consistency readers.

title: bibnets 0.2.0
text: Argument count renamed counting; measure renamed similarity across network functions. co_network() renamed conetwork().

title: bibnets 0.2.0
text: read_openalex() — reads OpenAlex JSON export. filter_top() — keeps top-n connected nodes. normalize() — post-hoc normalisation edge list.

title: bibnets 0.1.0
text: Initial release. 8 network builders: author_network(), document_network(), reference_network(), keyword_network(), institution_network(), country_network(), source_network(), conetwork(). 13 counting methods including harmonic, geometric, golden ratio, adaptive geometric. 6 similarity normalisations: association strength, cosine, Jaccard, inclusion, equivalence. 6 readers: Scopus, Web Science, OpenAlex, BibTeX, RIS, Lens.org. Converters: to_igraph(), to_tbl_graph(), to_matrix(). Numerically validated bibliometrix biblionetwork.
